plan.design: Simple unstratified sample of remaining unreviewed occurrence IDs, without replacement, selected by lowest seeded SHA-256 ranks. No length, lexical, risk or dialogue-uniqueness filter.
plan.excluded: Previously context-reviewed occurrences and exact reviewed-dialogue reuses.
plan.estimand: Occurrence-level automatic structural errors in the current unreviewed remainder, not entire-dialogue accuracy or factual-semantic equivalence.
plan.procedure: Record direct contextual meanings before opening saved automatic analyses; compare afterwards. One model reviewer, no independent human gold standard.
plan.limitation: 50 observations give a wide uncertainty interval. Syntax-only candidates do not supply reviewed factual semantics; missing semantic approval is a capability limit, not a successful semantic parse.

summary.baseline_semantic_status: UNREVIEWED for every selected occurrence; no scored factual-event semantics exists

interpretation: The 10/50 error count includes 7 dependency/POS differences and 3 compiled property-link errors.
The two source-defect cases are separate, not silently counted as successful parses.
The 38 remaining cases have no definite observed structural error; this does not mean automatic factual semantics is correct.
The interval estimates occurrence-level structural error in the unreviewed remainder conditional on this single reviewer's judgments.
This is not a head-to-head score for an independently verified manual pipeline, nor a training-quality benchmark.
Some full contexts have been seen in earlier work. The blind step hides the selected automatic analyses, not conversation history.
